Options:
  --detach                          Run in the background
  -d                                Run in the background
  --interactive                     Keep standard input open
  -i                                Keep standard input open
  --tty                             Allocate a pseudo-terminal
  -t                                Allocate a pseudo-terminal
  --name NAME                       Assign a container name
  --env KEY_VALUE                   Set an environment value
  -e KEY_VALUE                      Set an environment value
  --publish PORT                    Publish a container port
  -p PORT                           Publish a container port
  --volume VOLUME                   Mount a volume
  -v VOLUME                         Mount a volume
  --rm                              Remove the container after exit
  --workdir DIR                     Set the working directory
  --user USER                       Select the container user
